title: Theviyanthan Krishnamohan
description: I am a Ph.D. student in Computing Science researching Genetic Algorithms for autonomous networks at the University of Glasgow.
intro: I am a computer scientist and software engineer with an insatiable passion for problem-solving and continuous learning. I am ambitious about bridging science and engineering by experimentally evaluating novel research ideas and engineering them into scalable, user-friendly products. Currently, I am reading for a Ph.D. in Computing Science at the University of Glasgow, a world top-100 university, where I research enabling network autonomy using Genetic Algorithms. I have over 5 years of experience in the industry, 4 of which were spent designing and developing an open-source Identity and Access Management product that is recognised as a Strong Performer by Forrester. Outside of my professional work, I have contributed to impactful open-source projects, including software used to manage elections that were used to run national elections in Sri Lanka. Beyond technology, I am an ardent cricket analyst and regularly publish data-driven articles.
